credentials.h: Professional Software Developer Certification (PSDC) — Program Designer & Executor
credentials.text: Designed the certification program end-to-end — including all course outlines — and executed it fully. The program enrolled **160 under-privileged teenagers** in free software development training.

ielts.h: IELTS — International English Language Testing System

note: I hold no vendor certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, security, etc.). My cloud, AI, and architecture expertise comes from **22+ years of hands-on delivery** — enterprise engagements across the US, Pakistan, and the Middle East, practice leadership at Nisum, and division ownership at Folio3.
